freeze_timing: Before the running full study produces final test results
execution_gate: Both existing frozen full-study utility and matched-control gates pass; otherwise do not run this checkpoint diagnostic or rescue the recipe
selection: First64 distinct TRAIN examples in existing deterministic data order, all if fewer; retain every normally valid token
mode: eval; zero optimizer updates; existing shared scheduler after full allocation finishes; no Windows data/model payload
intervention: Eight Z2^3 characters on token return path amplitudes, shared across all tokens, relations and examples; relations, utilities, bias, EPS and masks fixed
zero_z_boundary: Use exact W Z^s matrix-orbit definition; any zero first-layer z makes the corresponding literal interior-angle reparameterization a limiting completion, report count
falsification: delta<=0 rejects the stated slice-level learned-orientation-benefit interpretation; no sample/branch/checkpoint rescue
positive_ceiling: Within-checkpoint TRAIN64 evidence only; no natural-text process-access necessity, heldout mediation, independent confirmation, novelty clearance or L5
supplementary: Exact weighted-logit-center and Walsh/Parseval identities, all eight CE values, nonidentity class log-odds changes; no materialized sample traces required beyond reconstructible final checkpoint and fixed cache
prohibitions: No alteration to running full-study gates
finite_precision_boundary: Report exact zero affected first-layer z and any tanh saturation at physical endpoints; matrix-orbit formula remains the explicit counterfactual, do not claim every realized float angle lies in the open-chart theorem.
